---
name: havenline-environment-review
description: Review actual Havenline environment render evidence and geometry; distinguish code verification from visual approval.
---
Read Docs/Art/EnvironmentReview/ACCEPTANCE.md. For environment changes, inspect
actual rendered screenshots in Docs/Art/EnvironmentReview/captures when present
and the associated Actions artifacts. Use image-capable tools if available;
do not claim to have opened pixels merely by reading an image filename.
Report code issues independently, then provide visual scores only for images
actually inspected. Evaluate front/rear/sides, normal gameplay and closeups,
night and blizzard, roof/snow/material joins, terrain contact, and camera edges.
Scores target10 and pass strictly above9 with every mandatory check. Preserve
source hashes and exact capture filenames. Unavailable visual inspection means
UNREVIEWED, not an inferred pass. Do not modify files or lower requirements.
